title: Certificate-verified target-column stopping on fresh K=75 cold IC targets

admission_stages.A_implementation: Approved executor handoff may implement the declared candidate, create a derived source copy, perform offline build, and run only the frozen deterministic unit suite. It reads pinned parent source and may write only its declared implementation/test scope. It launches no solver control or scientific process.
admission_stages.B_bind_implementation: Coordinator commits and hash-binds exact derived source/code, diffs, lock/dependency/toolchain closure, binaries, case manifest, runner/analyzer/checker, and unit-control evidence. Only after B is committed may the three untimed solver controls be authorized.
admission_stages.C_measurement_admission: Coordinator commits the three complete solver-control receipts and verifies every measurement-admission gate. Only then may one explicitly designated sole executor own the serial scientific launch; no other agent may launch a science child.

continuation.relationship: Second-ranked target-only stopping lead, designed independently of P2 results. It uses the reviewed R1 allocation-only ARM direct source, K=75 and eta=1/256; it does not select, change, or depend on P2.

prohibited: batching, retained logs/state, scalar access by collector, target reuse, weakened rho
asymptotic, SOTA, security, or cryptanalytic-break claims
scope.claim_ceiling: Any outcome is a finite implementation observation after independent review; it cannot change a research status alone.

sources_and_arms.baseline: Reviewed R1 allocation-only ARM IC source unchanged.
sources_and_arms.candidate_delta: Only affine/certificate-echelon state, RHS and row-combination tracking, first target-column-pivot stopping, and necessary truthful receipt/validation path may change. No field math, base, capacity, density, relation generation, RNG, witness policy, subgroup/base validation, rho, threads, CLI, or other algorithm path changes.
sources_and_arms.arm_backend_requirement: Every charged arm reports actual common ARM field backend; unexpected fallback refuses science.

certificate_and_correctness.relation_equation: For every admitted relation over F_r, A*f + b*d = a mod r, where A is the factor-coefficient vector, b is final stored coefficient, and a is separately stored coefficient_a.
certificate_and_correctness.candidate_method: During coefficient elimination, track RHS and row-combination weights. Stop at the first target-column pivot and return d only with a witness vector w such that wA=0, wb=1, and wa=returned_d modulo r.
certificate_and_correctness.charged_validation: Inside the charged candidate process, independently recompute wA, wb, and wa from all original admitted rows; reject on any mismatch. Retain independent base/subgroup validation, every admitted relation group check, and final [d]G=Q verification.
certificate_and_correctness.truthful_output: Candidate receipt reports TARGET_IDENTIFIED, actual coefficient and augmented ranks, target-pivot row/prefix, certificate digest, and no full-rank/log result unless one actually occurred. It may replace full-factor-log solution validation only with this complete target certificate plus requested-target proof.
certificate_and_correctness.collector_blindness: The relation collector receives no fixture scalar, target certificate, or success oracle beyond ordinary public target data and declared stop signal.
certificate_and_correctness.prefix_requirement: With original capacity/source/RNG, baseline and candidate must have identical relation-generation prefixes. Require common-prefix equality in small-field controls and offline for all 24 measured IC baseline/candidate mates. Any mismatch is preserved and invalidates its comparison; no retry.

frozen_panel.freshness_gate: Before controls or science, hash-pin a manifest proving these 24 scalars are pairwise distinct and disjoint from R1 and P2 scalar panels. Collision refuses the task; no substitution is allowed.
frozen_panel.seeds: Direct baseline/candidate share first8-little-endian-SHA256 uint64 seeds from CSIC53-TARGETSTOP-v1-direct-seed-XX. Rho uses analogous CSIC53-TARGETSTOP-v1-rho-seed-XX labels.
frozen_panel.assignment: Cycle the six lexicographic orders four times over cases 1..24. Each arm occurs eight times in each position. Each case has fresh serial processes/directories and no shared state/log/cache or retry.

preflight_and_unit_controls.solver_control_rule: Three serial one-worker controls use the frozen environment and actual ARM backend. Leading placeholders are executable paths, never literal argv tokens. They are untimed and excluded from 72 science children.

linear_system_controls.interpretation: All listed arithmetic is modulo p. Variables are (f0,f1,f2,d)=(2,3,5,7) modulo p.

early_target.meaning: Each row is [A0,A1,A2,b,RHS]. They determine d=7 at coefficient rank 2, strictly below four variables.

span_and_inconsistency.duplicate_and_scaled: Insert a duplicate and 3x-scaled first early-target row before its second row; preserve d=7 and valid certificate.
span_and_inconsistency.inconsistent: Duplicate the first early-target row with RHS+1; detect inconsistency explicitly before any target pivot.

linear_system_controls.checker_negative_controls: Independent checker rejects weights mutated from [-1,1], incorrect wb normalization, and returned d+1.

k75_certificate_bookkeeping.variables: f_j=j+2 mod p for j=0..74 and d=7.
k75_certificate_bookkeeping.rows_1_to_72: For j=0..71, row j+1 has A=e_j, b=0, RHS=f_j.
k75_certificate_bookkeeping.row_73: A_j=j+1 for j=0..71, A_74=1, all other A=0, b=1, RHS=dot(A,f)+b*d.
k75_certificate_bookkeeping.row_74: A_j=2*(j+1) for j=0..71, A_74=1, all other A=0, b=2, RHS=dot(A,f)+b*d.
k75_certificate_bookkeeping.expected: Target identifies at row 74, coefficient rank is 74<76, and certificate has first 72 weights=-(j+1), row73=-1, row74=1. This verifies nonzero weights on old pivot rows and target proof while factor columns 72 and 73 are missing.

preflight_and_unit_controls.group_and_prefix_controls: Require all group checks and final requested-output verification. Require common canonical relation-generation prefix for baseline/candidate in deterministic small-field controls and all 24 offline measured IC mates; do not require equal later elimination traces after target stop.
preflight_and_unit_controls.admission: Stage A unit tests are deterministic and do not require a produced binary admission. Stage B binds source/binary/toolchain, candidate diff, case generator, runner, analyzer, certificate checker, prefix checker and unit evidence before solver controls; Stage C binds solver-control receipts before science.

metrics_and_analysis.process_boundary: Whole process launch through wait4 reap, including setup, relation generation, query/elimination, certificate/validation, receipt, and exit. Build/toolchain costs are separate and unamortized.
metrics_and_analysis.primary: q_i=candidate whole-process wall/rho whole-process wall for all 24 valid pairs; eligible only if all 24 valid, median(q_i)<0.95, and paired-bootstrap upper 95% endpoint<1.00.
secondary: admitted-row counts and actual coefficient/augmented ranks
actual setup, relation, query/elimination, certificate, and validation stage costs
metrics_and_analysis.no_selection: No calibration, selection, old-panel reuse, best-of result, or adaptive stopping parameter exists.

resources.boundary: Cold means fresh solver state, fresh per-child directories, and fresh solver processes. It makes no OS-cache-flush or thermal-invariance assertion. Wall ends at wait4 reap. One-ms polling and 50-ms memory sampling are requested, not scheduling guarantees; record actual method/times. RSS/CPU are per PID wait4/child fields, never aggregate RUSAGE_CHILDREN. Darwin cap is cooperative.
resources.failure_rule: Timeout, cap, crash, source/prefix/certificate/correctness/telemetry failure is immutable, invalidates comparison, and is never retried or mathematical evidence.

proof_search_map.exact_baseline_reproduction: Reviewed R1 allocation-only ARM source/binary and current prefix reproduction.
proof_search_map.observation_collision_search: Zero-b, target-unit, duplicate/rescale, inconsistent-RHS, small-prime, actual-modulus, and group/certificate controls.
proof_search_map.quantifier_statement: Fixed source, host, 24 deterministic known answers, K=75/eta=1/256, one-thread cold processes, and certificate correctness only.
proof_search_map.method_ceiling: No timing saving, asymptotic change, or method superiority is assumed; full-cost fresh-target controls can falsify the mechanism.

artifacts.immutability: Artifacts and failures are additive only.
